title: Text: DET Dan Lunetta ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: You sticking around or just dropping those guys off?
Ah, ok. That's why I was waiting. Later
Do you want to get dinner? On the Free Press, of course
Thanks Anthony but I’m back in Lakeland. I was only dropping off those guys.
Yeah I know. I have a car and four hours to kill
Ok...thanks for the invite but I have a Wednesday night thing I do with my son.
No problem, thanks for getting back to me. Have fun
Thanks. See you at the winter meetings
